description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Terrarion, adding {C}{C}.
Terrarion leaves the battlefield, triggering itself and Sly Requisitioner.
Resolve the Terrarion trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Sly Requisitioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
The Servo dies, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Terrarion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
